nl.title: Problemen met e-mail / website / controlpanel?
nl.excerpt: Eerste hulp bij mail-/site-/panelproblemen: isoleer laag (DNS, SSL, app, mail).
nl.bodyHtml:
Structureel troubleshooten voorkomt willekeurig knoppen drukken.

Voorbereiding

  • Tijdstip
  • Fouttekst
  • Wel/niet via 4G

Stappen

  1. Bepaal scope: alleen jij / iedereen
  2. Check DNS naar juiste IP
  3. Check SSL-datum
  4. Check panel usage/suspend
  5. Check app (WP critical) vs. kale HTML-testbestand
  6. Check mail via webmail vs. client
  7. Ticket met feiten als vast

Controleren

  • Oorzaaklaag benoemd

Tip: Een test.html in public_html scheidt app van server.

Let op: Meerdere fixes tegelijk maken root-cause onvindbaar.

Kom je er na deze stappen niet uit? Open een ticket bij TripleZero iT via het klantenpanel. Vermeld hostname, DirectAdmin-gebruikersnaam (geen wachtwoord), domein en wat je al probeerde.

Gerelateerd: cant-login; wp-critical.

en.excerpt: Problems with email / website / controlpanel: steps in DirectAdmin for problemen, mail, website.
en.bodyHtml:
For Problems with email / website / controlpanel follow a targeted checklist in DirectAdmin. Core themes: problemen, mail, website.

Preparation

  • Access to DirectAdmin
  • Focus of this article: problemen, mail, website
  • Note of the current setting/status

Steps

  1. Work in DirectAdmin. Stay on the topic problemen, mail, website — no parallel experiments.
  2. Select the correct domain/user account in DirectAdmin.
  3. Open the module that fits problemen (Email, DNS, File Manager, SSL, Cron Jobs, MySQL or Installatron).
  4. Note the current status, then apply only what “Problems with email / website / controlpanel” requires around mail.
  5. Save and test outside DirectAdmin (browser, webmail, DNS lookup or cron log).
  6. Document what you changed around problemen, mail, website (old → new value) for support.

Verify

  • Result for problemen, mail, website matches “Problems with email / website / controlpanel”
  • No regression on a critical flow beside problemen met e mail
  • External test or second browser/network confirms the result

Tip: Work in small steps: get problemen, mail, website right first, then optional extras.

Note: Do not blindly change production without a backup if problemen, mail, website touches login, DNS, mail or payments.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: DirectAdmin, backups, tickets.
